content: Folol Kofal Hammal Ngalir Maelhafohoy
“Habe kemahoy bo hade la faor wegdeg kala ye momay bo yami kawerwer luwul yarmat. Hare ha bela kawerwer wegdeg ka luwul yarmat cholop, ngo tor paliyal le be holahmi mo irel mala Tammi wol laeng.

“Iwe ngo yodla habe fang formel ngal semal yarmat le yesa kkel yal hafohoy, ngo ha towe tap kawerwer mala hasa foru, bo hade la tappilir rechokla rema forgirloh lal imwel mepel ka iwe mo lal yalap. Rema foru bo fal mala yarmat rebe ma hapingpingar. Ibe hatugulu ngalugmi le sa faesul moll paliyer le resa ngaler.
Iwe ngo yodla ho bela tipingi semal yarmat le sa kkel yal hafohoy, ngo hobe foru le mala mwo maryarem le ye kkel yami fel fengal ngo towe gola kofal.
Ila ngo hami chog llufulumi mele habe gola kofal. Ngo mala Tammi bela wiri mala hosa foru le yarmat re togla ngo be fang paliyal ngalug.
Folol Kofal Mapel

“Yodla habe mepel ngo ha towe wochog rechokla rema forgirloh. Rema dipli bo rebe su ngo resa mepel lal imwel mepel ka, iwe mo tabtabol yalap ka bo pangal yarmat ngo rebe wirir. Ibe hatugulu ngalugmi le rechoka ila sa moll paliyer.
Yodla habe mepel ngo hasa loh lal senggil kala yami hasa pilta hatam, ngo hasa mepel ngal mala Tammi le site ma wiri. Ngo mala Tammi ye wiri molwe hasa foru le hami loh chog ila yebe holbuwahmi.
“Yodla habe mepel ngo ha towe hacholpa hapatpat kala tor pelal bo hade wochog Gentiles kowe re luluwaley le Deus be rongrong yalor bo ye lellay mepel kala yar.
Towe ila sengal yami mapel. Mala Tammi sa faesul gola mekla ha hafohoy iyang mo imol mala habe dangro.
Be iye sengal yami ma mapel:

content.text: Be ssor mala idem le ye santus;
le habe talenga yalom woal talop le be wochog woal laeng.
Fang ngalugmem mongoy la habe hangi igla.
Hachuya fael tayikof kala hasa foru,
le be wochog yamem hachuya fael tayikof kala resa foru ngalugmem.
Ho towe hasugmemloh irel hagelgel la ye weres,
bo hobe hadorahmem mo irel Moniyan.’
[Bo mala Lamliyem, mo ssor, mo falmay la yam ila tor siyal. Amen.]

content: “Hare habe hachuya mo lal yami luluwal mekla re faor ngalugmi le ye tayikof ngo mala Tammi wol laeng be wol hachuya mo lal yal luluwal tayikof kala hasa foru.
Iwe ngo hare habe te hachuya mo lal yami luluwal tayikof kala sibis resa faor ngalugmi ngo be wol ila sengal mala Tammi wol laeng bo towe hachuya mo lal yal luluwal tayikof kala hami hasa foru.
Folol Kofal Yach Ma Supiy Halach

“Yodla ha bela supiy halmi ngo ha towe ma hafohoyuloh wol metami bo hade la wochog rechokwe rema forgirloh fael metal yarmat. Ir ila re tay ma hallimdir bo yarmat rebe gola le resa supiy haler. Ibe hatugulu ngalugmi le rechokla ila sa faesul moll paliyer.
Yodla hobe supiy halam gel semal ngo hobe ma yurmat ngo ho taldi chomom,
bo rede gola le hosa supiy halam, bo halachog mala Tammi le si tema wiri mele be gola. Ngo mala Tammi le ye wiri mekla ha foru llufulumi mele yebe holbuwahmi.
Mmal La Wol Laeng
“Ha towe hattey mmalmi mo wol talop bo churchur de hatawsi hare ye yewloh hare chomachoh re peraloh.
Ha far hattey mmalmi mo wol laeng, le churchur towe hatawsi ngo towe yewloh ngo towe yoh le chomachoh rebe pere;
bo luluwal kala yami ila pangal yad ngo be mel chog lobola ye mel mmal kala yami iyang.
Mala Termal Holong
“Meka metach ila ye wochog sew habul le hawrel holong. Hare be ffod metami ngo be wol teram mekla holongmi,

ngo hare ha metafis le tayorloh mele hama wiri, ila ngo mekla holongmi ila be mel luwul rochupung. Iwe ngo hare bela torloh teram la lal mekla dipmi ila ngo be ifa lepal yal rochupung lal mekla dipmi!
Kofal Deus Mo Kofal Yach Mmal

“Ye towe fel le be semal boy ngo rumal yal masta; bo ila ngo yebe hachangi semal ngo ye hafobidiri ila semal; hare yebe momay wegdegel ngal semal ngo ye tolpagililoh ila semal. Towe yoh le hobe mel bo boyel Deus ngo ho wol mel bo boyel salpiy.

“Ila fal le ikangalugmi bo: ha towe merhagili bo de tor mele habe mongoy hare ha yul bo habe molow, hare ha merhagili bo de tor mengag le habe mengag iyang. Ifa sengal, te palleng pelal molow mo imol mongoy? Iwe ngo te palleng pelal holong mo imol mengag?
Ha kemahor mael yeyal ka: re tema fod milay ngo re tema gil uwal milay re sala haliliya lal soko; mala Tammi wol laeng mele ma hammaler. Ifa sengal, ye te palleng pelami mo imor mael yeyal ka?
Itey semal hami le be yoh le be hassulayiloh tot yodol yal molow irel yal merhagililoh chog?
“Meda fal le habe merhagili bo de tor mengagmi iyang? Ha kemahoy floras kala ye tumuldah chog le re tema yengang ngo re tema ffaor mengagur.
Ibe kangalugmi le King Solomon mwo le ye mmal, ngo tor mengagol le ye wochog kamdidiyel sepoy floras ka.

Deus mele ye hamengagu fadil ka iy chog yal tumuldah le fadil ka ye mel igla ngo la walsu ngo ye tamel loh bo yesa fisngegloh. Te fasul tugul le Deus yebe fang mengagumi? Ila lepal wechichil yami tugul!
“Ila ha towe merhagili hare: ‘Iya lobole be budoh ha lai, mo limmi, mo mengagoi mo iyang?’
(Ika meka Gentiles rema toa luluwaleloh chog.) Pangal mekla habe mmal iyang ngo mala Tammi wol laeng ye gola.
Pangal meka ngo Deus be hammal ngalugmi igle ha itol dipmi irel yami foru yengangel mala Lamliyel Deus mo mekla ye fel depal iyang.
Ha towe merhagili kofal walsu bo ye wol cholop mekla sibe luwaley irel kofal walsu. Tor fal le sibe wol chila mekla weresel seral mo seral.
